verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for an email platform, so the story applies. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The changelog's 'triggers' that draft replies and connect to 3,000+ apps, plus the Zapier and Tasklet integrations, are in-app automations and third-party connectors rather than webhook subscriptions. No public API or OpenAPI spec was found either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
